text: DEFONEOS — DLUHC Housing, Planning & Local Government AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 — Transparency & Compliance: This pack maps sovereign AI governance obligations for DLUHC housing allocation, planning decisions, and local government systems. High-risk classification under Annex III. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DLUHC × Housing × Planning × Local Government DLUHC Housing, Planning & Local Government AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for the Department for Levelling Up, Housing & Communities — covering planning reform, social housing allocation, building safety, local government finance, and community empowerment across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Housing 1. Social Housing Allocation Council housing waiting lists (1.2M+ households), allocation algorithms, homelessness duty, Housing Act 1996 compliance. Band-based allocation, transfer management, succession rights, and nomination agreements with registered providers across 317 English local authorities. Planning 2. Planning Permission & Development Planning application processing (400K+/year), local plan development, permitted development rights, enforcement. Major/minor application classification, committee decision support, Section 106 agreements, CIL charging, and planning appeal case management. Safety 3. Building Safety & Remediation Building Safety Act 2022 implementation, cladding remediation programme (£5.1bn), Building Safety Regulator, higher-risk building gateway process. Fire safety compliance, remediation tracking, developer contribution agreements, and leaseholder protection. Finance 4. Local Government Finance Council tax administration, business rates retention, Revenue Support Grant, levelling up fund allocation. Financial resilience monitoring, intervention powers, capital programme oversight, and audit compliance across 317 councils and 10 combined authorities. Community 5. Community Empowerment Neighbourhood planning, community right to bid, asset transfer, participatory budgeting. Community Organisers programme, parish council support, and hyper-local democratic engagement infrastructure. Devolution 6. Devolution & Combined Authorities 10 combined authorities with elected metro mayors, devolution deals, trailblazer powers, investment funds. Mayoral combined authority governance, transport integration, skills devolution, and further devolution pipeline. Levelling Up 7. Levelling Up Missions 12 levelling up missions — living standards, R&D, transport, broadband, education, pride in place, homeownership, wellbeing, local leadership, crime, devolution. Mission tracking dashboards, fund allocation (UKSPF, Levelling Up Fund, Towns Fund). Regeneration 8. Urban Regeneration & Land Brownfield land registers, Housing Infrastructure Fund, garden communities, new towns. Land assembly, compulsory purchase, remediation, and development corporation oversight for major regeneration sites. Homelessness 9. Homelessness Prevention Rough sleeping strategy, Housing First pilots, prevention duty, relief duty, main duty. Duty to refer, accommodation procurement, support needs assessment, and vulnerability tracking for 300K+ households in temporary accommodation. Digital 10. Digital Planning & Data Planning data strategy, open-source planning registers, digital site notices, BIM integration. PropTech innovation, geospatial planning data, and Local Digital Declaration compliance across planning authorities. Regulation 11. Regulatory Oversight Intervention powers (Secretary of State), best value inspections, commissioners, statutory directions. Corporate governance standards, officer delegation schemes, and standards committee oversight. Accountability 12.
